title: Kula Ag Park expansion and new farm reservoir
summary: Bill 23 would add $10 million for the State Department of Agriculture to use on Upcountry Maui agricultural park work. Earlier, in February 2025, a council member asked staff to follow up on how funding for the Kula Ag Park was being distributed.
